origin.label: hypothesis

established.fact: NHC: low expected to form along a weakening front NE of the Bahamas; 7-day 20%
NHC labels it AL94; to be absorbed by a new non-tropical low to its east
NHC last mention: merges with a frontal system in a day or two
IPMA names CHARLES (communiqué no. 1); no origin stated

origin.hypothesis: the new non-tropical low that absorbed AL94 is, or became part of, CHARLES
against: no source says so; NHC never names the absorbing low; IPMA gives no origin; Wikipedia's editor's note says sources don't state it
several lows coexist in the subtropical Atlantic
origin.wikipedia_date_note: NHC labels AL94 on 6 Nov 11:37Z, not 7 Nov
